quote.text: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
quote.author: Carl Sagan, The Demon-Haunted World (1995), popularising a formulation of the astronomer Martin Rees

stories.kicker: The Arctic · an agreement announced before it exists
stories.headline: Three governments confirmed the same Greenland deal. None has published it.
stories.dek: Washington calls it permanent control; Copenhagen calls it recognition of sovereignty. It is due to be signed in New York this week — and a Danish lecturer’s verdict is that the Americans have held these rights since 1951.

stories.kicker: Down the rabbit hole · knife making
stories.headline: Everything they argue about is one trade-off: how hard, against how tough.
stories.dek: Steel names, quench recipes, twenty-year forum feuds — all of it a position on one axis. And the step that decides whether a blade works is the one you cannot see.

stories.headline: Không nhận chuyển khoản
stories.dek: “We don’t accept bank transfers.” Handwritten, taped to a till, in the country that grew QR payment value eighty-five per cent in a year. Vietnam has just run the world’s first large experiment on whether digital-payment adoption is a ratchet. It is not.

stories.kicker: The haze · a statute that has never once been used
stories.headline: Singapore has a law for this. In twelve years it has opened no investigation.
stories.dek: In February the environment minister explained why: the haze had not reached levels that would warrant one. The peak then was a PSI of 69; on 15 September, Central read 154.

stories.kicker: Buy it once · the lamp on your desk
stories.headline: A lamp with an unreplaceable LED has a service life, not a lifetime.
stories.dek: The specification that decides whether you still own the thing in twenty years is the socket — and it is never on the front of the box.

stories.kicker: Sovereignty · the browser becomes the front line
stories.headline: Firefox’s assistant now runs on Mistral. Mozilla will not say where the thinking happens.
stories.dek: The announcement is four paragraphs long and contains a zero-data-retention promise, two launch territories and no model name. For a reader who owns the hardware to run this himself, the omission is the whole product.

stories.kicker: Wearables · it ships, and the price lands
stories.headline: The Ultra 4 samples your heart every five seconds. It shows you one reading in five.
stories.dek: Singapore price S$1,199, on shelves since Friday. The reviewer who measures these things for a living calls the sensor the best Apple has made — then documents twenty-second holes in the data during hard efforts.

stories.kicker: Escapes · the Cairnhill corner, filled at last
stories.headline: Hilton is putting NoMad on Orchard Road, with a fourteen-storey waterfall and 1,860 artworks.
stories.dek: A hundred and seventy-three rooms over twelve floors on the old Faber House site, WOHA outside, Kevin Klein inside — and roughly nine in ten of the pictures by artists based here. Opening is “late 2026”; no rate has been published.

stories.kicker: Television · the record, and the reviews that don’t match it
stories.headline: A freshman comedy won fourteen Emmys. Its Metascore is 78, the lowest of the night’s winners.
stories.dek: Matthew Rhys became the first person to take two lead acting Emmys in one year. The show he did it for has a critical temperature that runs a long way below the industry’s enthusiasm for it — and one review at 40.

stories.kicker: Twelve · the year the first phone arrives
stories.headline: A study of 3,486 children who had no phone at twelve. Half of them got one.
stories.dek: It was accepted thirteen days ago and it is not a screen-time paper. It is a paper about one particular year — and its own mediation analysis says the phone is not what does the damage.

stories.kicker: The regime · diversification stopped working in all four directions
stories.headline: Equities fell, bonds fell, and gold sat twenty-two per cent under its own record.
stories.dek: Stocks and bonds have moved together for a month — daily-return correlation +0.57 over twenty-one sessions, +0.67 last week. That is not a bad week for a sixty-forty; it is the signature of an inflation-shock regime.

stories.kicker: The long game · a trial that split the session up
stories.headline: Three short bouts across a day beat nothing, and lost to one session on every measure.
stories.dek: The differences were not statistically significant — which is not the same as equal. The finding worth having is that the fragmented group enjoyed it more.

stories.kicker: The diary · eighteen days to the street circuit
stories.headline: What is worth booking, and two dates this desk will not print as settled.
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a promoter, a venue or an official ticketing page. Two shows carry conflicting dates across sources and are flagged rather than dropped; Singapore’s three biggest ticketing hosts refused this desk outright, so several famous names are absent for that reason alone.
